objects.name: Argonaut
objects.description: Rovan’s ONE Bastion-derived Argonaut, refitted with his newfound wealth. UNIQUE silhouette: elongated rigid bronze Zeppelin central hull, two shorter side gun hulls, wedge-shaped armoured ram prow and reinforced lower keel; crimson lacquer side armour between bronze ribs, low protected command citadel, TWO exposed green magnetic stabiliser rings near the stern, FOUR articulated bronze vectoring thruster pods with green Type B glow, rebuilt gun positions. Veymarch SILVER broken shield/eight-point star on crimson banners. Workshop-built industrial machinery, not ornate fantasy gold or a generic round-nosed Bastion.
constraints: Exactly one Argonaut. No extra friendly capital ship. Do not add wooden hulls, sails, balloons or other vessels from references.
Same ship after a refit, never an additional capital ship.
All hull armour is bronze Type A; machinery is green Type B. No silver Type C hull or invulnerability.
Canonical Argonaut refit design controls hull geometry; older generic Bastion art supplies ancestry only.
Keep the wedge prow, crimson side armour, paired green stern stabiliser rings and vectoring pods recognisable in every new exterior view.

PURPOSE: Regenerate ONE comic illustration for FIXED holder 1536.00 by 1024.00 logical pixels, aspect 1.5000:1. LANDSCAPE. Requested output 1248x832. Do NOT resize or redesign the holder. Paint a NEW composition for it, not a framed photo.

SCENE: A dedicated landscape illustration of Rovan’s Argonaut in a dockside REFIT WORKSHOP at the conquered floating city. Exactly ONE capital ship, its full side and three-quarter bow visible, fixed to dry-dock braces, cranes and scaffold gantries, being upgraded by small human civilian workers in practical work clothes. At lower left, Rovan in navy/crimson surveys the work, a small recognisable figure. The completed upgrades are clearly visible at once: long bronze Zeppelin central hull and two shorter side gun hulls, a sharp WEDGE-SHAPED ARMOURED RAM PROW unlike the old blunt Bastion, reinforced lower keel, broad CRIMSON side armour panels framed by bronze ribs, low protected bridge citadel, TWO exposed upright green magnetic stabiliser rings near the stern, FOUR articulated bronze vectoring thruster pods, rebuilt gun mounts. Rivets, tool marks, bolted service access and practical construction. Not a balloon, not a wooden sailboat, not a cathedral. Type A bronze armour, green Type B engines, NO silver hull or Type C plating. Crimson Veymarch banner bears a SILVER broken shield/star. Full ship silhouette stays inside canvas with space for caption and narration. This single new image shows how captured wealth pays for the refit; no combat or enemy ships.
CAMERA: Use a clear, tightly composed shot with the important action filling the aperture; do not copy the old wide framing.

STYLE: Magneton graphic novel: painted ink, tactile bronze machinery, silver Type C, crimson Veymarch cloth, navy/gold Auric Reach uniforms; atmospheric floating islands. Consistent with supplied scene references, not photorealistic.
